title.zh: 卷十 帝紀第十 帝 恭帝
title.en: Volume 10 Annals 10: Emperor An; Emperor Gong
title.raw: 卷十 帝紀第十 帝 恭帝 Volume 10 Annals 10: Emperor An; Emperor Gong

sentences.zh: 安皇帝諱德宗，字德宗，孝武帝長子也。

translations.literal: The Emperor An, taboo name Dezong, courtesy name Dezong, was the eldest son of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An, whose taboo name was Dezong and whose courtesy name was likewise Dezong, was the eldest son of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin.

sentences.zh: 太元十二年八月辛巳，立爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the eighth month in the twelfth year of Taiyuan, he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Taiyuan 12 (387 CE), on the day xinsi, he was invested as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 二十一年九月庚申，孝武帝崩。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, on the gengshen day of the ninth month, Emperor Xiaowu died.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiyuan 21 (396 CE), on gengshen in the ninth month, Emperor Xiaowu passed away.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太子卽皇帝位，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the crown prince assumed the imperial throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the crown prince ascended the throne as emperor and ordered a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以司徒、會稽王道子爲太傅，攝政。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Minister of Education and Prince of Guiji, Daozi, was appointed Grand Tutor and took charge of the government.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Sima Daozi, minister of education and Prince of Guiji, was made grand tutor and assumed regency.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiashen day.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month: the day jiashen.

sentences.zh: 葬孝武皇帝于隆平陵。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu was buried at Longping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: They buried Emperor Xiaowu at Longping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 大雪。

translations.literal: Heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: There was heavy snowfall.

sentences.zh: 隆安元年春正月己亥朔，帝加元服，改元，增文武位一等。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Longan, on the first day jihai, the emperor underwent the capping rite, the era name was changed, and civil and military ranks were advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month of Longan 1 (397 CE), new moon on jihai: the emperor came of age, the reign title was changed, and all civil and military officials gained one rank.

sentences.zh: 太傅、會稽王道子稽首歸政。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor, Prince of Guiji, Daozi, bowed his head and returned the government.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Sima Daozi, Prince of Guiji, formally handed back the reins of government.

sentences.zh: 以尚書右僕射王珣爲尚書令，領軍將軍王國寶爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Right of the Secretariat Wang Xun was made Director of the Secretariat, and General of the Garrison Army Wang Guobao was made Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xun was appointed director of the secretariat from his post as right vice director; Wang Guobao, general of the garrison army, became left vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二月，呂光將禿髮烏孤自稱大都督、大單于，國號南涼。

translations.literal: In the second month, Lü Guang's general Tufa Wugu styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief and Great Chanyu, with the state name Southern Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Tufa Wugu, a general under Lü Guang, declared himself grand commander-in-chief and great chanyu and founded the state of Southern Liang.

sentences.zh: 擊光將竇苟于金昌，大破之。

translations.literal: He attacked Lü Guang's general Dou Gou at Jinchang and inflicted a great defeat on him.
translations.idiomatic: He struck Lü Guang's general Dou Gou at Jinchang and routed him decisively.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，尊皇太后李氏爲皇太后。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Lady Li, the empress dowager, was honored with the standing of empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the court formally confirmed Lady Li as empress dowager with full rites of investiture.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立皇后王氏。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Empress Wang was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Lady Wang was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 三月，呂光子纂爲乞伏乾歸所敗。

translations.literal: In the third month, Lü Guang's son Zuan was defeated by Qifu Gan'gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Lü Zuan, son of Lü Guang, was beaten by Qifu Gan'gui.

sentences.zh: 光建康太守段業自號涼州牧。

translations.literal: Lü Guang's prefect of Jiankang, Duan Ye, styled himself shepherd of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ye, Lü Guang's prefect of Jiankang, proclaimed himself governor of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 慕容寶敗魏師于薊。

translations.literal: Murong Bao defeated Wei forces at Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Bao repulsed the Wei army at Ji.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，兗州刺史王恭，豫州刺史庾楷舉兵，以討尚書左僕射王國寶、建威將軍王緒爲名。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiaxu, the inspector of Yanzhou, Wang Gong, and the inspector of Yuzhou, Yu Kai, raised troops in the name of punishing Vice Director of the Left Wang Guobao and General Who Establishes Might Wang Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, jiaxu: Wang Gong, inspector of Yanzhou, and Yu Kai, inspector of Yuzhou, rose in arms, nominally to punish Wang Guobao, left vice director of the secretariat, and Wang Xu, general who establishes might.

sentences.zh: 甲申，殺國寶及緒以悅于恭，恭乃罷兵。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Guobao and Xu were killed to please Gong, and Gong then disbanded his army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wang Guobao and Wang Xu were executed to placate Wang Gong, who thereupon stood down his forces.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 五月，前司徒長史王廞以吳郡反，王恭討平之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the former chief clerk of the minister of education, Wang Xin, rebelled in Wu commandery, and Wang Gong suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wang Xin, erstwhile chief clerk of the minister of education, revolted in Wu commandery; Wang Gong crushed the rising.

sentences.zh: 慕容寶將慕容詳僭卽皇帝位于中山，寶奔黃龍。

translations.literal: Murong Bao's general Murong Xiang usurped the imperial title at Zhongshan; Bao fled to Huanglong.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Xiang, a general of Murong Bao, unlawfully took the imperial title at Zhongshan, while Bao fled toward Huanglong.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，呂光爲其僕射楊軌、散騎常侍郭黁所攻，光子纂擊走之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Lü Guang was attacked by his vice director Yang Gui and cavalier attendant for regular service Guo Fen; Lü Guang's son Zuan drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Lü Guang came under attack from his vice director Yang Gui and regular cavalier attendant Guo Fen; his son Lü Zuan beat them back.

sentences.zh: 九月，慕容寶將慕容麟斬慕容祥于中山，因僭卽皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Murong Bao's general Murong Lin beheaded Murong Xiang at Zhongshan and thereupon usurped the imperial title.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Murong Lin, Murong Bao's general, executed Murong Xiang at Zhongshan and then unlawfully proclaimed himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，慕容麟爲魏師所敗。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Murong Lin was defeated by Wei forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Murong Lin suffered defeat at the hands of the Wei army.

sentences.zh: 二年春三月，龍舟二災。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring in the second year, two dragon boats were destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Longan, two imperial dragon boats burned.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，蘭汗弑慕容寶而自稱大將軍、昌黎王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Lan Han murdered Murong Bao and styled himself grand general and Prince of Changli.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Lan Han assassinated Murong Bao and declared himself grand general and king of Changli.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，慕容寶子盛斬蘭汗，僭稱長樂王，攝天子位。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Murong Bao's son Sheng executed Lan Han and usurped the title Prince of Changle, assuming the position of the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Murong Sheng, Bao's son, killed Lan Han and unlawfully took the title prince of Changle, exercising imperial authority.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史王恭、豫州刺史庾楷、荊州刺史殷仲堪、廣州刺史桓玄、南蠻校尉楊佺期等舉兵反。

translations.literal: The inspector of Yanzhou, Wang Gong; the inspector of Yuzhou, Yu Kai; the inspector of Jingzhou, Yin Zhongkan; the inspector of Guangzhou, Huan Xuan; and the colonel of the southern barbarians, Yang Quanqi, among others, raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong of Yanzhou, Yu Kai of Yuzhou, Yin Zhongkan of Jingzhou, Huan Xuan of Guangzhou, and Yang Quanqi, colonel of the southern barbarians, jointly rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 八月，江州刺史王愉奔于臨川。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the inspector of Jiangzhou, Wang Yu, fled to Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wang Yu, inspector of Jiangzhou, bolted to Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，寧朔將軍鄧啓方及慕容德將慕容法戰于管城，王師敗績。

translations.literal: On bingzi, General Who Calms the Northern Frontier Deng Qifang and Murong De's general Murong Fa fought at Guancheng; the imperial army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Deng Qifang, general who calms the northern frontier, clashed with Murong Fa, a general of Murong De, at Guancheng; the government forces were badly beaten.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，慕容盛僭卽皇帝位于黃龍。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Murong Sheng usurped the imperial title at Huanglong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Murong Sheng unlawfully ascended the throne at Huanglong.

sentences.zh: 桓玄大敗王師于白石。

translations.literal: Huan Xuan inflicted a great defeat on the imperial army at Baishi.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan shattered the imperial army at Baishi.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，加太傅、會稽王道子黃鉞。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the ninth month, the Grand Tutor, Prince of Guiji, Daozi, was given the yellow battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the ninth month Grand Tutor Sima Daozi, Prince of Guiji, was granted the yellow axe, emblem of punitive command.

sentences.zh: 遣征虜將軍會稽王世子元顯、前將軍王珣、右將軍謝琰討桓玄等。

translations.literal: General Who Subdues the Caitiffs, heir apparent of the Prince of Guiji, Yuanxian; former general Wang Xun; and general of the right Xie Yan were sent to campaign against Huan Xuan and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched Sima Yuanxian, heir of the Prince of Guiji, as general who subdues the caitiffs, together with former general Wang Xun and right general Xie Yan, to strike Huan Xuan and his allies.

sentences.zh: 己亥，破庾楷于牛渚。

translations.literal: On jihai, Yu Kai was defeated at Niuzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai government troops defeated Yu Kai at Niuzhu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，會稽王道子屯中堂，元顯守石頭。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Prince of Guiji, Daozi, encamped at the Central Hall, and Yuanxian guarded Stone Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Prince Daozi of Guiji took position in the Central Hall while Yuanxian held Stone Fortress.

sentences.zh: 己酉，前將軍王珣守北郊，右將軍謝琰備宣陽門。

translations.literal: On jiyou, former general Wang Xun guarded the northern suburb, and general of the right Xie Yan secured Xuanyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou former general Wang Xun defended the northern outskirts and right general Xie Yan covered Xuanyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍劉牢之次新亭，使子敬宣擊敗恭，恭奔曲阿長塘湖，湖尉收送京師，斬之。

translations.literal: General Who Supports the State Liu Laozhi halted at Xinting and sent his son Jingxuan to strike and defeat Gong; Gong fled to Changtang Lake in Qu'e, where the lake warden seized him and sent him to the capital, and he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Laozhi, general who supports the state, stopped at Xinting and had his son Liu Jingxuan attack Wang Gong; Gong fled to Changtang Lake in Qu'e, was captured by the lake bailiff and sent to the capital, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 於是遣太常殷茂喻仲堪及玄，玄等走于尋陽。

translations.literal: Thereupon Minister of Ceremonies Yin Mao was sent to remonstrate with Zhongkan and Xuan, and Xuan and the others fled to Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: The court then sent Yin Mao, minister of ceremonies, to reason with Yin Zhongkan and Huan Xuan, who withdrew toward Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，新野言騶虞見。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Xinye reported that a zouyu had appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Xinye reported the sighting of a zouyu, the auspicious white tiger-like beast.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大赦。

translations.literal: On bingzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 壬午，仲堪等盟于尋陽，推桓玄爲盟主。

translations.literal: On renwu, Zhongkan and the others swore a covenant at Xunyang and promoted Huan Xuan as covenant lord.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Yin Zhongkan and his allies made a league at Xunyang and acknowledged Huan Xuan as head of the alliance.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以琅邪王德文爲衛將軍、開府儀同三司，領軍將軍王雅爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Prince of Langye, Dewen, was made General Who Guards the State, with equal ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, and General of the Garrison Army Wang Ya was made Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, became general who guards the state with honors matching the three excellencies, while Wang Ya, general of the garrison army, was appointed left vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，魏王珪卽尊位，年號天興。

translations.literal: On jichou of the twelfth month, the Wei king Gui assumed the exalted position, with era name Tianxing.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the twelfth month Tuoba Gui, king of Wei, took the imperial title with the era name Tianxing.

sentences.zh: 京兆人韋禮帥襄陽流人叛，降于姚興。

translations.literal: Wei Li of Jingzhao led displaced people from Xiangyang in revolt and surrendered to Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Li of the capital region led Xiangyang refugees in mutiny and went over to Yao Xing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，前新安太守杜炯反于京口，會稽王世子元顯討斬之。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the former prefect of Xin'an, Du Jiong, rebelled at Jingkou, and the heir apparent of the Prince of Guiji, Yuanxian, campaigned against him and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Du Jiong, former prefect of Xin'an, mutinied at Jingkou; Sima Yuanxian, heir of the Prince of Guiji, attacked him and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 禿髮烏孤自稱武威王。

translations.literal: Tufa Wugu styled himself Prince of Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Tufa Wugu proclaimed himself prince of Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛酉，封宗室蘊爲淮陵王。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the first month of spring in the third year, a member of the imperial clan, Yun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Huailing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the first month of the third year of Longan a clansman, Sima Yun, was invested as prince of Huailing.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，河間王國鎮薨。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the second month, the Prince of Hejian, Guozhen, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the second month Sima Guozhen, prince of Hejian, died.

sentences.zh: 林邑范胡達陷日南、九真，遂寇交阯，太守杜瑗討破之。

translations.literal: Fan Huda of Linyi took Rinan and Jiuzhen, then raided Jiaozhi; Prefect Du Yuan attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: The Linyi ruler Fan Huda seized Rinan and Jiuzhen and struck Jiaozhi; Prefect Du Yuan repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 段業自稱涼王。

translations.literal: Duan Ye styled himself King of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ye declared himself king of Liang.

sentences.zh: 仇池公楊盛遣使稱籓，獻方物。

translations.literal: The lord of Chouchi, Yang Sheng, sent envoys declaring submission and presented local tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sheng, lord of Chouchi, sent envoys to acknowledge Jin suzerainty and offer tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，追尊所生陳夫人爲德皇太后。

translations.literal: On jimao of the third month, the Lady Chen who bore the emperor was posthumously honored as Virtuous Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the third month the emperor's birth mother, Lady Chen, was canonized posthumously as empress dowager de (virtuous).

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，加尚書令王珣衛將軍，以會稽王世子元顯爲揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiwei of summer, the fourth month, Director of the Secretariat Wang Xun was additionally made General Who Guards the State, and the heir apparent of the Prince of Guiji, Yuanxian, was made inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the fourth month Wang Xun, director of the secretariat, was further named general who guards the state, and Sima Yuanxian, heir of the Prince of Guiji, became inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，以琅邪王德文爲司徒。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the sixth month, the Prince of Langye, Dewen, was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the sixth month Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 慕容德陷青州，害龍驤將軍辟閭渾，遂僭卽皇帝位于廣固。

translations.literal: Murong De took Qingzhou, killed General Who Rouses the Dragon Pi Lu Hun, and thereupon usurped the imperial title at Guanggu.
translations.idiomatic: Murong De overran Qingzhou, slew Pi Lu Hun, general who rouses the dragon, and then unlawfully took the throne at Guanggu.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，禿髮烏孤死，其弟利鹿孤嗣偽位。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Tufa Wugu died, and his younger brother Lilugu inherited the false position.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Tufa Wugu died; his brother Tufa Lilugu succeeded to his usurped title.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，姚興陷洛陽，執河南太守辛恭靖。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Yao Xing took Luoyang and captured the governor of Henan, Xin Gongjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yao Xing seized Luoyang and took Xin Gongjing, governor of Henan, prisoner.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，妖賊孫恩陷會稽，內史王凝之死之，吳國內史桓謙、臨海太守新蔡王崇、義興太守魏隱並委官而遁，吳興太守謝邈、永嘉太守司馬逸皆遇害。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the eleventh month, the sorcerer-rebel Sun En took Kuaiji; Interior Secretary Wang Ningzhi died in the affair; Interior Secretary of Wu Huan Qian, Prefect of Linhai Prince Chong of Xincai, and Prefect of Yixing Wei Yin all abandoned office and fled; Prefect of Wuxing Xie Miao and Prefect of Yongjia Sima Yi were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the eleventh month the rebel Sun En captured Kuaiji; Interior Secretary Wang Ningzhi perished; Huan Qian of Wu, Prince Chong of Xincai in Linhai, and Wei Yin of Yixing all fled their posts; Xie Miao of Wuxing and Sima Yi of Yongjia were slain.

sentences.zh: 遣衛將軍謝琰、輔國將軍劉牢之逆擊，走之。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the State Xie Yan and General Who Supports the State Liu Laozhi were sent to intercept and strike them, and they were driven off.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Xie Yan, general who guards the state, and Liu Laozhi, general who supports the state, to intercept the rebels and force their retreat.

sentences.zh: 十二月，桓玄襲江陵，荊州刺史殷仲堪、南蠻校尉楊佺期並遇害。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Huan Xuan raided Jiangling; the inspector of Jingzhou, Yin Zhongkan, and the colonel of the southern barbarians, Yang Quanqi, were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Huan Xuan stormed Jiangling; Yin Zhongkan, inspector of Jingzhou, and Yang Quanqi, colonel of the southern barbarians, both fell.

sentences.zh: 呂光立其太子紹爲天王，自號太上皇。

translations.literal: Lü Guang established his heir apparent Shao as heavenly king and styled himself supreme emperor father.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Guang installed his crown prince Lü Shao as heavenly king while taking for himself the title supreme father-emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日，光死，呂纂弑紹而自立。

translations.literal: That same day Guang died, and Lü Zuan murdered Shao and established himself.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Lü Guang died; Lü Zuan assassinated Lü Shao and seized power.

sentences.zh: 是歲，荊州大水，平地三丈。

translations.literal: That year, Jingzhou suffered great flooding; on level ground the water stood three zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: That year a catastrophic flood struck Jingzhou, with still water three zhang deep even on the plains.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥，大赦。

translations.literal: On yihai of the first month of spring in the fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the first month of the fourth year of Longan the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，有星孛于奎婁，進至紫微。

translations.literal: On jichou of the second month, a star appeared broom-like in Kui and Lou and advanced into the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the second month a comet appeared in the Kui-Lou asterism and moved toward the Purple Palace enclosure.

sentences.zh: 三月，彗星見于太微。

translations.literal: In the third month, a comet appeared in the Supreme Palace enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month a comet showed itself within the Supreme Palace constellation.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，地震。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an earthquake occurred.

sentences.zh: 孫恩寇浹口。

translations.literal: Sun En raided Jiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En struck Jiakou.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，散騎常侍、衛將軍、東亭侯王珣卒。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the fifth month, Cavalier Attendant for Regular Service, General Who Guards the State, Marquis of Dongting, Wang Xun, died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fifth month Wang Xun, regular cavalier attendant and general who guards the state, Marquis of Dongting, died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，會稽內史謝琰爲孫恩所敗，死之。

translations.literal: On jimao, the interior secretary of Kuaiji, Xie Yan, was defeated by Sun En and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Xie Yan, interior secretary of Kuaiji, was routed by Sun En and killed.

sentences.zh: 恩轉寇臨海。

translations.literal: En then turned to raid Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En then swung his forces against Linhai.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the first day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, new moon of the sixth month, an eclipse of the sun occurred.

sentences.zh: 旱。

translations.literal: Drought.
translations.idiomatic: A severe drought set in.

sentences.zh: 輔國司馬劉裕破恩於南山。

translations.literal: Assistant to the General Who Supports the State Liu Yu defeated En at Nanshan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, aide to the general who supports the state, broke Sun En at Nanshan.

sentences.zh: 恩將盧循陷廣陵，死者三千餘人。

translations.literal: En's general Lu Xun took Guangling; more than three thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun, Sun En's lieutenant, captured Guangling, leaving over three thousand dead.

sentences.zh: 以琅邪王師何澄爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: The tutor to the Prince of Langye, He Cheng, was made Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He Cheng, tutor to the Prince of Langye, was appointed left vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，太皇太后李氏崩。

translations.literal: On renzi of the seventh month of autumn, Grand Empress Dowager Li died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the seventh month Grand Empress Dowager Lady Li died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大赦。

translations.literal: On dingmao, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a general amnesty was issued.

sentences.zh: 是月，姚興伐乞伏乾歸，降之。

translations.literal: That month, Yao Xing attacked Qifu Gan'gui and made him submit.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Yao Xing campaigned against Qifu Gan'gui and forced his surrender.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，尚書右僕射王雅卒。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the eighth month, Vice Director of the Right of the Secretariat Wang Ya died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the eighth month Wang Ya, right vice director of the secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，葬文太后于脩平陵。

translations.literal: On renyin, Empress Dowager Wen was buried at Xiuping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Empress Dowager Wen was interred at Xiuping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，地震。

translations.literal: On guichou of the ninth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the ninth month the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，寧朔將軍高雅之及孫恩戰於餘姚，王師敗績。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, General Who Calms the Northern Frontier Gao Yazhi fought Sun En at Yuyao; the imperial army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Gao Yazhi, general who calms the northern frontier, met Sun En at Yuyao and the government army was routed.

sentences.zh: 以揚州刺史元顯爲後將軍、開府儀同三司、都督揚豫徐兗青幽冀幷荊江司雍梁益交廣十六州諸軍事，前將軍劉牢之爲鎮北將軍，封元顯子彥璋爲東海王。

translations.literal: The inspector of Yangzhou, Yuanxian, was additionally made General of the Rear, with equal ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, area commander over sixteen provinces' military affairs, former general Liu Laozhi was made General Who Guards the North, and Yuanxian's son Yanzhang was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yuanxian, inspector of Yangzhou, was further named general of the rear with three-excellency honors and area commander for sixteen provinces; Liu Laozhi became general who guards the north; Yuanxian's son Sima Yanzhang was invested prince of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，有星孛于天市。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the twelfth month, a star appeared broom-like in the Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the twelfth month a comet blazed in the Celestial Market asterism.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河右諸郡奉涼武昭王李玄盛爲秦涼二州牧、涼公，年號庚子。

translations.literal: That year, the commanderies west of the River offered allegiance to Li Gao, courtesy name Xuansheng, the man later canonized as Prince Wu-Zhao of Liang, as shepherd of Qin and Liang and Duke of Liang, with era name Gengzi.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Hexi commanderies acclaimed Li Gao (courtesy Xuansheng), whom later history remembers as Prince Wu-Zhao of Liang, as governor of Qin and Liang and duke of Liang, with the reign title Gengzi.

sentences.zh: 五年春二月丙子，孫恩復寇浹口。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the fifth year, on bingzi, Sun En again raided Jiakou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the second month of the fifth year of Longan Sun En again struck Jiakou.

sentences.zh: 呂超殺呂纂，以其兄隆僭卽偽位。

translations.literal: Lü Chao killed Lü Zuan, and his elder brother Long usurped the false position.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Chao murdered Lü Zuan, allowing his brother Lü Long unlawfully to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，衆星西流，歷太微。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the third month, many stars flowed westward through the Supreme Palace enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the third month a meteor shower swept westward across the Supreme Palace enclosure.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，孫恩寇𣺣瀆，吳國內史袁山松死之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Sun En raided Hudu (the Hu River ford); Interior Secretary of Wu Yuan Shansong died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Sun En struck the Hu ford (near modern Shanghai); Yuan Shansong, interior secretary of Wu, was killed in the defense.

sentences.zh: 沮渠蒙遜殺段業，自號大都督、北涼州牧。

translations.literal: Juqu Mengxun killed Duan Ye and styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief and shepherd of Northern Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Juqu Mengxun slew Duan Ye and proclaimed himself grand commander-in-chief and governor of northern Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，孫恩至丹徒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu of the sixth month, Sun En reached Dantu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the sixth month Sun En's host reached Dantu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，內外戒嚴，百官入居于省。

translations.literal: On yihai, inside and outside were placed on alert, and the hundred officials took up residence within the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the capital went on full alert and all officials billeted themselves inside the palace offices.

sentences.zh: 冠軍將軍高素、右衛將軍張崇之守石頭，輔國將軍劉襲柵斷淮口，丹陽尹司馬恢之戍南岸，冠軍將軍桓謙、輔國將軍司馬允之、遊擊將軍毛邃備白石，左衛將軍王嘏、領軍將軍孔安國屯中皇堂。

translations.literal: General Who Wins the Championship Gao Su and General of the Right Zhang Chongzhi guarded Stone Fortress; General Who Supports the State Liu Xi palisaded the crossing at the Huai mouth; Prefect of Danyang Sima Huizhi garrisoned the south bank; General Who Wins the Championship Huan Qian, General Who Supports the State Sima Yunzhi, and General Who Roams and Strikes Mao Sui prepared Baishi; General of the Left Wang Jia and General of the Garrison Army Kong Anguo encamped at the Central Imperial Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Su, general who wins the championship, and Zhang Chongzhi, general of the right, held Stone Fortress; Liu Xi, general who supports the state, threw a stockade across the Huai estuary; Sima Huizhi, prefect of Danyang, manned the south bank; Huan Qian, Sima Yunzhi, and Mao Sui covered Baishi; Wang Jia, general of the left, and Kong Anguo, general of the garrison army, camped at the Central Imperial Hall.

sentences.zh: 徵豫州刺史、譙王尚之衛京師。

translations.literal: The inspector of Yuzhou, Prince Shang of Qiao, was summoned to defend the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sima Shang of Qiao, inspector of Yuzhou, was recalled to shield the capital.

sentences.zh: 寧朔將軍高雅之擊孫恩于廣陵之郁洲，爲賊所執。

translations.literal: General Who Calms the Northern Frontier Gao Yazhi attacked Sun En at Yuzhou off Guangling and was captured by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yazhi, general who calms the northern frontier, engaged Sun En at Yuzhou islet near Guangling and was taken by the rebels.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，段璣殺慕容盛，盛叔父熙盡誅段氏，因僭稱尊號。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Duan Ji killed Murong Sheng; Sheng's uncle Xi exterminated the Duan clan entirely and thereupon usurped the exalted title.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Duan Ji assassinated Murong Sheng; Murong Xi, Sheng's uncle, wiped out the Duan lineage and then unlawfully assumed the throne.

sentences.zh: 九月，呂隆降于姚興。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Lü Long surrendered to Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Lü Long submitted to Yao Xing of Later Qin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，姚興帥師侵魏，大敗而旋。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Yao Xing led an army against Wei, suffered a great defeat, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yao Xing invaded Wei, was routed, and limped home.

sentences.zh: 是歲，饑，禁酒。

translations.literal: That year there was famine, and wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Famine gripped the realm, and the court banned the sale and drinking of wine.

sentences.zh: 元興元年春正月庚午朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Yuanxing, on the first day gengwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month of Yuanxing 1, new moon on gengwu: the court ordered a general amnesty and adopted the new reign title Yuanxing.

sentences.zh: 以後將軍元顯爲驃騎大將軍、征討大都督，鎮北將軍劉牢之爲元顯前鋒，前將軍、譙王尚之爲後部，以討桓玄。

translations.literal: General of the Rear Yuanxian was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Grand Commander-in-Chief for Punitive Expeditions, General Who Guards the North Liu Laozhi was made his vanguard, former general Prince Shang of Qiao was made rear echelon, to campaign against Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxian, general of the rear, received the titles grand general of agile cavalry and supreme commander against rebellion; Liu Laozhi, general who guards the north, led his van; Prince Sima Shang of Qiao, former general, covered the rear, all mobilized to crush Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，帝戎服餞元顯于西池。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the second month, the emperor in martial garb held a farewell feast for Yuanxian at the West Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the second month the emperor, dressed for war, saw Yuanxian off with a banquet at the West Pool.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣兼侍中、齊王柔之以騶虞幡宣告荊、江二州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Concurrent Palace Attendant, Prince of Qi Rouzhi was dispatched with the zouyu banner to proclaim the edict in Jing and Jiang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Sima Rouzhi, Prince of Qi, holding concurrent palace attendant rank, carried the zouyu standard into Jingzhou and Jiangzhou to publish the imperial command.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，桓玄敗王師于姑孰，譙王尚之、齊王柔之並死之。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Huan Xuan defeated the imperial army at Gushi; Prince Shang of Qiao and Prince Rouzhi of Qi both died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Huan Xuan shattered government troops at Gushi; Prince Shang of Qiao and Prince Rouzhi of Qi fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 以右將軍吳隱之爲都督交廣二州諸軍事、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: General of the Right Wu Yin-zhi was made area commander over the military affairs of Jiao and Guang provinces and inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yin-zhi, general of the right, became area commander for Jiao and Guang and inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，劉牢之叛降于桓玄。

translations.literal: On jisi of the third month, Liu Laozhi rebelled and surrendered to Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the third month Liu Laozhi turned traitor and went over to Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，王師敗績于新亭，驃騎大將軍、會稽王世子元顯，東海王彥璋，冠軍將軍毛泰，遊擊將軍毛邃並遇害。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the imperial army was routed at Xinting; Grand General of Agile Cavalry, heir apparent of the Prince of Guiji, Yuanxian; Prince Yanzhang of Donghai; General Who Wins the Championship Mao Tai; and General Who Roams and Strikes Mao Sui were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the loyalist army collapsed at Xinting; Sima Yuanxian, grand general of agile cavalry and heir of the Prince of Guiji, Sima Yanzhang of Donghai, Mao Tai, general who wins the championship, and Mao Sui, general who roams and strikes, all perished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，桓玄自爲侍中、丞相、錄尚書事，以桓謙爲尚書僕射，遷太傅、會稽王道子于安城。

translations.literal: On renshen, Huan Xuan made himself palace attendant, chancellor, and recorder of the secretariat matters, appointed Huan Qian vice director of the secretariat, and moved Grand Tutor, Prince of Guiji, Daozi to Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Huan Xuan seized the offices of palace attendant, chancellor, and chief of secretariat affairs, named Huan Qian vice director of the secretariat, and banished Grand Tutor Sima Daozi, Prince of Guiji, to Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 玄俄又自稱太尉、揚州牧，總百揆，以琅邪王德文爲太宰。

translations.literal: Xuan soon also styled himself grand commandant and shepherd of Yangzhou, taking overall charge of affairs, and made the Prince of Langye, Dewen, grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan shortly added the titles grand commandant and governor of Yangzhou, claiming direction of all government, while naming Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, grand preceptor in name.

sentences.zh: 臨海太守辛景擊孫恩，斬之。

translations.literal: The prefect of Linhai, Xin Jing, attacked Sun En and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Jing, prefect of Linhai, struck Sun En and took his head.

sentences.zh: 是月，禿髮利鹿孤死，弟辱檀嗣偽位。

translations.literal: That month, Tufa Lilugu died, and his younger brother Rutan inherited the false position.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Tufa Lilugu died; his brother Tufa Rutan succeeded to his usurped throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，新蔡王崇爲其奴所害。

translations.literal: On yihai of autumn, the seventh month, Prince Chong of Xincai was murdered by his slaves.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the seventh month Sima Chong, Prince of Xincai, was assassinated by his household slaves.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，尚書下舍災。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the eighth month, the lower offices of the secretariat caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the eighth month a blaze destroyed the lower compound of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，冀州刺史劉軌叛奔于慕容德。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the inspector of Jizhou, Liu Gui, rebelled and fled to Murong De.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Liu Gui, inspector of Jizhou, mutinied and defected to Murong De.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，會稽王道子爲桓玄所害。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the twelfth month, the Prince of Guiji, Daozi, was killed by Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the twelfth month Huan Xuan had Sima Daozi, Prince of Guiji, murdered.

sentences.zh: 曲赦廣陵、彭城大逆以下。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for Guangling and Pengcheng down from the crime of high treason.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued a limited amnesty for Guangling and Pengcheng, pardoning offenses short of the gravest treason.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月辛丑，建威將軍劉裕破徐道覆于東陽。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the second month of spring in the second year, General Who Establishes Might Liu Yu defeated Xu Daofu at Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the second month of the second year of Yuanxing Liu Yu, general who establishes might, routed Xu Daofu at Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，桓玄自稱大將軍。

translations.literal: On yimao, Huan Xuan styled himself grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Huan Xuan proclaimed himself grand general.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，冀州刺史孫無終爲桓玄所害。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the inspector of Jizhou, Sun Wuzhong, was killed by Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Sun Wuzhong, inspector of Jizhou, fell victim to Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On guisi, the first day of summer, the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: New moon on guisi in the fourth month brought an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，玄又自號相國、楚王。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Xuan again styled himself minister of state and King of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Huan Xuan added the titles minister of state and king of Chu.

sentences.zh: 九月，南陽太守庾仄起義兵，爲玄所敗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the prefect of Nanyang, Yu Ze, raised loyal troops and was defeated by Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yu Ze, prefect of Nanyang, rose in arms against Huan Xuan but was beaten.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬午，玄遷帝于永安宮。

translations.literal: On renwu of winter, the eleventh month, Xuan moved the emperor to Yongan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the eleventh month Huan Xuan removed the emperor to confinement in Yongan Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，移太廟神主于琅邪國。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the spirit tablets of the Grand Temple were transferred to the state of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the ancestral tablets were carried from the dynastic temple into the princely domain of Langye.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，玄篡位，以帝爲平固王。

translations.literal: On renchen of the twelfth month, Xuan usurped the throne and made the emperor Prince of Pinggu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the twelfth month Huan Xuan seized the throne and demoted the emperor to prince of Pinggu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，帝蒙塵于尋陽。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the emperor suffered dishonor at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the sovereign endured captivity and humiliation at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月，帝在尋陽。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the third year, the emperor was at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Yuanxing the emperor remained under guard at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅夜，濤水入石頭，漂殺人戶。

translations.literal: On gengyin night, tidal surge entered Stone Fortress, drowning people and households.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengyin a tidal bore swept into Stone Fortress and swept away lives and homes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，建武將軍劉裕帥沛國劉毅、東海何無忌等舉義兵。

translations.literal: On yimao, General Who Establishes Might Liu Yu led Liu Yi of Pei, He Wuji of Donghai, and others in raising loyal troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Liu Yu, general who establishes might, rallied Liu Yi of Pei, He Wuji of Donghai, and others in a loyalist uprising.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，斬桓玄所署徐州刺史桓修于京口，青州刺史桓弘于廣陵。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Huan Xuan's appointee as inspector of Xuzhou, Huan Xiu, was beheaded at Jingkou, and the inspector of Qingzhou, Huan Hong, at Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen loyalists executed Huan Xiu, Huan Xuan's man as inspector of Xuzhou, at Jingkou, and Huan Hong, inspector of Qingzhou, at Guangling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，義師濟江。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the loyalist army crossed the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the righteous host forded the Great River.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，劉裕斬玄將吳甫之于江乘，斬皇甫敷於羅落。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the third month, Liu Yu beheaded Xuan's general Wu Fuzhi at Jiangcheng and Huangfu Fu at Luoluo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the third month Liu Yu slew Wu Fuzhi, a general of Huan Xuan, at Jiangcheng and Huangfu Fu at Luoluo.

sentences.zh: 己未，玄衆潰而逃。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Xuan's host broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Huan Xuan's army disintegrated in flight.

sentences.zh: 庚申，劉裕置留臺，具百官。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Liu Yu established a rear headquarters and fully staffed the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Liu Yu set up a provisional administration at the capital with a complete roster of officials.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，桓玄司徒王謐推劉裕行鎮軍將軍、徐州刺史、都督揚徐兗豫青冀幽幷八州諸軍事、假節。

translations.literal: On renxu, Huan Xuan's minister of education Wang Mi recommended Liu Yu to act as General Who Garrisons the Army, inspector of Xuzhou, and area commander over the military affairs of eight provinces, with credential baton.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Mi, minister of education under Huan Xuan, urged that Liu Yu act as general who garrisons the army, inspector of Xuzhou, and area commander for eight provinces, bearing the ceremonial axe.

sentences.zh: 劉裕以謐領揚州刺史、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Liu Yu had Mi concurrently hold the inspectorate of Yangzhou and recorder of secretariat matters.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu left Wang Mi in charge of Yangzhou and overall secretariat business.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，劉裕誅尚書左僕射王愉、愉子荊州刺史綏、司州刺史溫詳。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Liu Yu executed Vice Director of the Left Wang Yu, Yu's son the inspector of Jingzhou, Sui, and the inspector of Sizhou, Wen Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Liu Yu put to death Wang Yu, left vice director of the secretariat, together with Wang Sui, his son and inspector of Jingzhou, and Wen Xiang, inspector of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，桓玄逼帝西上。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Huan Xuan forced the emperor westward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Huan Xuan drove the emperor upriver toward the west.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，密詔以幽逼於玄，萬機虛曠，令武陵王遵依舊典，承制總百官行事，加侍中，餘如故。

translations.literal: On bingxu, a secret edict stated that, being cruelly coerced by Xuan with all governance empty, Prince Zun of Wuling was ordered according to old precedent to assume provisional authority over the hundred offices, with addition of palace attendant, other titles unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu a clandestine rescript explained that, smothered by Huan Xuan's tyranny with the court paralyzed, Prince Sima Zun of Wuling should exercise delegated authority over all offices per established precedent and receive the added title palace attendant, retaining his existing honors.

sentences.zh: 幷大赦謀反大逆己下，惟桓玄一祖之後不宥。

translations.literal: At the same time a general amnesty was proclaimed for conspiracy and high treason downward, except that no grace extended to the posterity of one ancestor of Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: A sweeping amnesty followed for all crimes through high treason, explicitly excluding the single ancestral line of Huan Xuan from mercy.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，大將軍、武陵王遵稱制，總萬機。

translations.literal: On jichou of summer, the fourth month, Grand General Prince Zun of Wuling assumed provisional rule and took charge of all affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the fourth month Sima Zun, grand general and Prince of Wuling, began acting as regent over the entire administration.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，帝至江陵。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the emperor reached Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor arrived at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，輔國將軍何無忌、振武將軍劉道規及桓玄將庾稚、何澹之戰于湓口，大破之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, General Who Supports the State He Wuji, General Who Rouses Might Liu Daogui, and Xuan's generals Yu Zhi and He Danzhi fought at Penkou and inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu He Wuji, general who supports the state, and Liu Daogui, general who rouses might, met Yu Zhi and He Danzhi, generals of Huan Xuan, at Penkou and shattered their force.

sentences.zh: 玄復逼帝東下。

translations.literal: Xuan again forced the emperor eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan then compelled the emperor to travel back downriver toward the east.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，冠軍將軍劉毅及桓玄戰于崢嶸洲，又破之。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the fifth month, General Who Wins the Championship Liu Yi fought Huan Xuan at Zhengrong Islet and again defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fifth month Liu Yi, general who wins the championship, engaged Huan Xuan at Zhengrong Islet and won another victory.

sentences.zh: 己卯，帝復幸江陵。

translations.literal: On jimao, the emperor again proceeded to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the sovereign once more came to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，荊州別駕王康產、南郡太守王騰之奉帝居于南郡。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Provincial Aide Wang Kangchan and Prefect of Nanjun Wang Tengzhi lodged the emperor in Nanjun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Wang Kangchan, provincial aide of Jingzhou, and Wang Tengzhi, prefect of Nanjun, sheltered the emperor within Nanjun.

sentences.zh: 壬午，督護馮遷斬桓玄於貊盤洲。

translations.literal: On renwu, Superintendent Feng Qian beheaded Huan Xuan at Mopan Islet.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Feng Qian, army superintendent, executed Huan Xuan on Mopan Islet.

sentences.zh: 乘輿反正于江陵。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned to legitimacy at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial train was restored to its rightful authority at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔曰：「姦凶篡逆，自古有之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an edict said: "Treasonous usurpation by villains has existed since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the throne issued a rescript: "Violent usurpation is no novelty in history.

sentences.zh: 朕不能式遏杜漸，以致播越。

translations.literal: We were unable to check evil at its source, and therefore suffered exile.
translations.idiomatic: We failed to choke off treason before it spread, and so were cast into wandering exile.

sentences.zh: 賴鎮軍將軍裕英略奮發，忠勇絕世，冠軍將軍毅等誠心宿著，協助同嘉謀。

translations.literal: Thanks to General Who Garrisons the Army Liu Yu's brilliant strategy and stirring loyalty without peer, and to General Who Wins the Championship Liu Yi and others whose sincere hearts were long proven, joining in worthy counsel.
translations.idiomatic: We owe our deliverance to Liu Yu, general who garrisons the army, whose loyal valor and decisive genius are unmatched, and to Liu Yi, general who wins the championship, and others whose steadfast devotion long stood clear as they shared in righteous planning.

sentences.zh: 義聲旣振，士庶效節，社稷載安，四海齊慶。

translations.literal: Once the cry of justice resounded, gentlemen and commoners alike showed their fealty; the altars of soil and grain were again secure, and within the four seas all rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: When the call to arms rang out, officials and people alike rallied; the altars stood firm once more, and the realm rejoiced as one.

sentences.zh: 其大赦，凡諸畏逼事屈逆命者，一無所問。

translations.literal: Let there be a great amnesty; all who were intimidated into bowing to the usurper's orders are wholly forgiven."
translations.idiomatic: We therefore proclaim a great amnesty: none who submitted under duress to the rebel command shall be questioned."

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，奉神主人于太廟。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the spirit tablets were escorted into the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the ancestral tablets were solemnly returned to the dynastic temple.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，桓玄故將揚武將軍桓振陷江陵，劉毅、何無忌退守尋陽，帝復蒙塵于賊營。

translations.literal: On jichou of the intercalary month, former general of Yangwu under Huan Xuan, Huan Zhen, took Jiangling; Liu Yi and He Wuji withdrew to defend Xunyang, and the emperor again suffered dishonor in the rebel camp.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary fourth month, jichou: Huan Zhen, Huan Xuan's old general of yangwu, seized Jiangling; Liu Yi and He Wuji fell back to Xunyang, and the emperor once more endured captivity in the rebel lines.

sentences.zh: 六月，益州刺史毛璩討偽梁州刺史桓希，斬之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the inspector of Yizhou, Mao Qu, campaigned against the false inspector of Liangzhou under Huan Xuan, Huan Xi, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Mao Qu, inspector of Yizhou, attacked Huan Xi, the bogus governor of Liangzhou whom Huan Xuan had installed, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，永安皇后何氏崩。

translations.literal: On wushen of autumn, the seventh month, Empress Yongan, Lady He, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the seventh month Empress He of Yongan passed away.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，祔葬穆帝章皇后于永平陵。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the eighth month, Empress Zhang of Emperor Mu was buried by secondary interment at Yongping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the eighth month Empress Zhang of Emperor Mu received joint burial at Yongping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 九月，前給事中刁騁、秘書丞王邁之謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, former palace consultant Diao Cheng and secretary aide Wang Maizhi plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Diao Cheng, former consultant at court, and Wang Maizhi, secretary aide, conspired to revolt and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，盧循寇廣州，刺史吳隱之爲循所敗。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Lu Xun raided Guangzhou, and the inspector, Wu Yin-zhi, was defeated by Xun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Lu Xun struck Guangzhou; Wu Yin-zhi, the inspector, was routed.

sentences.zh: 執始興相阮腆之而還。

translations.literal: He seized the minister of Shixing, Ruan Tianzhi, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun captured Ruan Tianzhi, minister of Shixing, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 慕容德死，兄子超嗣偽位。

translations.literal: Murong De died, and his nephew Chao inherited the false position.
translations.idiomatic: Murong De died; his nephew Murong Chao succeeded to his usurped throne.

sentences.zh: 義熙元年春正月，帝在江陵。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Yixi, the emperor was at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yixi 1 the emperor still resided at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 南陽太守魯宗之起義兵，襲破襄陽。

translations.literal: The prefect of Nanyang, Lu Zongzhi, raised loyal troops and stormed Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zongzhi, prefect of Nanyang, mustered loyalist forces and broke into Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，劉毅次于馬頭。

translations.literal: On jichou, Liu Yi halted at Matou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Liu Yi encamped at Matou.

sentences.zh: 桓振以帝屯于江津。

translations.literal: Huan Zhen quartered the emperor at the Yangzi ford.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Zhen planted the emperor's retinue at the river crossing above Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宗之破振將溫楷于柞溪，進次紀南，爲振所敗。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zongzhi defeated Zhen's general Wen Kai at Zuoxi, advanced to Ji south of the city, and was defeated by Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Lu Zongzhi routed Wen Kai, a general of Huan Zhen, at Zuoxi, pushed on to camp south of the inner wall, but Huan Zhen then defeated him.

sentences.zh: 振武將軍劉道規擊桓謙，走之。

translations.literal: General Who Rouses Might Liu Daogui attacked Huan Qian and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Daogui, general who rouses might, struck Huan Qian and put him to flight.

sentences.zh: 乘輿反正，帝與琅邪王幸道規舟。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage was restored; the emperor and the Prince of Langye boarded Liu Daogui's boat.
translations.idiomatic: With the throne set right again, the emperor and Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, took refuge aboard Liu Daogui's ship.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「朕以寡德，夙纂洪緒。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict said: "We, of scant virtue, early inherited the great line.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict declared: "We, lacking in virtue, early took up the vast succession.

sentences.zh: 不能緝熙遐邇，式遏姦宄。

translations.literal: We were unable to bring light far and near or to block treacherous villains.
translations.idiomatic: We could not illumine the realm near and far nor stem treason at its root.

sentences.zh: 逆臣桓玄乘釁肆亂，乃誣罔天人，篡據極位。

translations.literal: The rebellious subject Huan Xuan seized the occasion to run riot, deceiving Heaven and man alike and usurping the supreme seat.
translations.idiomatic: The traitor Huan Xuan exploited disorder, hoodwinked Heaven and humanity, and seized the highest throne.

sentences.zh: 朕躬播越，淪胥荒裔，宣皇之基，眇焉以墜。

translations.literal: Our person was cast into wandering and sank to the wild borderlands; the foundation laid by Emperor Xuan teetered on the verge of collapse.
translations.idiomatic: We ourselves were driven into exile to the barbarous marches; the patrimony of Emperor Xuan hung by a thread.

sentences.zh: 賴鎮軍將軍裕忠武英斷，誠冠終古。

translations.literal: Thanks to General Who Garrisons the Army Liu Yu's loyalty, martial prowess, and heroic decisiveness, his sincerity crowns all ages.
translations.idiomatic: It was through Liu Yu, general who garrisons the army, whose loyalty, courage, and resolute genius surpass every precedent, that we were saved.

sentences.zh: 運謀機始，貞賢協其契；

translations.literal: From the first turning of the stratagem's pivot, the loyal and worthy were of one accord with him;
translations.idiomatic: From the very first stroke of planning, true men of worth moved in perfect concert with him;

sentences.zh: 抆淚誓衆，義士感其心。

translations.literal: He wiped his tears and swore the host to the cause, and men of principle were stirred in their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: He brushed away tears and bound the army with oaths, and every man of honor felt his spirit answered.

sentences.zh: 故霜戈一揮。

translations.literal: Therefore frost-bright weapons swung in a single stroke.
translations.idiomatic: Then cold-shining steel swept down in one arc.

sentences.zh: 巨猾奔迸，三率棱威，大憝授首。

translations.literal: The arch-villain broke and fled; the allied commanders displayed their stern majesty, and the chief culprit was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The great traitor scattered in flight; the loyal hosts showed their terrible edge, and the ringleader was struck down.

sentences.zh: 而孽振倡狂，嗣凶荊郢。

translations.literal: Yet the evil spawn Zhen ran wild, prolonging slaughter in Jing and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Yet that remnant Huan Zhen raged on, prolonging bloodshed across Jing and Ying.

sentences.zh: 幸天祚社稷，義旗載捷，狡徒沮潰，朕獲反正。

translations.literal: Fortunately Heaven guarded the altars; the banner of righteousness carried victory, the cunning pack broke and scattered, and We have been restored.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven preserved the altars: the righteous standard triumphed, the crafty rabble melted away, and We are returned to the throne.

sentences.zh: 斯實宗廟之靈，勤王之勳。

translations.literal: This is truly the numinous power of the ancestral temples and the merit of those who defended the king.
translations.idiomatic: This is the blessing of the imperial shrines and the valor of every lord who rose for the house of Jin.

sentences.zh: 豈朕一人，獨享伊祜，思與億兆，幸茲更始。

translations.literal: How could We alone enjoy such good fortune? We wish to share with the myriad people this renewal.
translations.idiomatic: How could We hoard this grace? We mean to share this new beginning with every household under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 其大赦，改元，唯玄振一祖及同黨不在原例。

translations.literal: Let there be a great amnesty and a change of era name; only Xuan, Zhen, and their one ancestral line and fellow partisans fall outside the ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: We therefore order a great amnesty and a new reign title, exempting from grace only Huan Xuan, Huan Zhen, their shared lineage, and their hard-core accomplices.

sentences.zh: 賜百官爵二級，鰥寡孤獨穀人五斛，大酺五日。」

translations.literal: Let the hundred officials each advance two noble ranks; widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless shall receive five hu of grain per person; let there be five days of general feasting."
translations.idiomatic: All officials shall rise two ranks in nobility; widowers, widows, orphans, and the destitute shall receive five hu of grain each; and the capital shall keep five days of public rejoicing."

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，留臺備乘輿法駕，迎帝于江陵。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the second month, the rear headquarters prepared the imperial train and full regalia to welcome the emperor from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the second month the provisional administration arrayed the imperial carriages and escort to bring the sovereign home from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 弘農太守戴寧之、建威主簿徐惠子等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: The prefect of Hongnong, Dai Ningzhi, chief clerk for establishment of might Xu Huizi, and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Ningzhi, prefect of Hongnong, Xu Huizi, chief clerk on the staff of the general who establishes might, and others conspired to revolt and were executed.

sentences.zh: 平西參軍譙縱害平西將軍、益州刺史毛璩，以蜀叛。

translations.literal: Army aide on the staff of the general who pacifies the west, Qiao Zong, murdered General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yizhou Mao Qu and rebelled with Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zong, aide to the general who pacifies the west, assassinated Mao Qu, general who pacifies the west and inspector of Yizhou, and raised Shu in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 三月，桓振復襲江陵，荊州刺史司馬休之奔于襄陽。

translations.literal: In the third month, Huan Zhen again raided Jiangling; the inspector of Jingzhou, Sima Xiuzhi, fled to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Huan Zhen struck Jiangling again; Sima Xiuzhi, inspector of Jingzhou, bolted to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 建威將軍劉懷肅討振，斬之。

translations.literal: General Who Establishes Might Liu Huaisu campaigned against Zhen and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huaisu, general who establishes might, attacked Huan Zhen and took his head.

sentences.zh: 帝至自江陵。

translations.literal: The emperor arrived from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 乙未，百官詣闕請罪。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the hundred officials went to the palace gate to acknowledge guilt.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the entire bureaucracy presented itself at the gate to confess fault.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「此非諸卿之過，其還率職。

translations.literal: An edict said: "This is not the fault of you ministers; return each to his duties."
translations.idiomatic: The court announced: "None of you is at fault; go back to your offices."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，舉章皇后哀三日，臨于西堂。

translations.literal: On wuxu, mourning for Empress Zhang was observed for three days, and the emperor kept vigil in the West Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the court observed three days of mourning for Empress Zhang, and the sovereign held vigil in the West Hall.

sentences.zh: 劉裕及何無忌等抗表遜位，不許。

translations.literal: Liu Yu and He Wuji and others submitted memorials declining office; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, He Wuji, and their colleagues petitioned to resign their commands; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以琅邪王德文爲大司馬，武陵王遵爲太保，加鎮軍將軍劉裕爲侍中、車騎將軍、都督中外諸軍事。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Prince of Langye, Dewen, was made grand marshal, Prince Zun of Wuling was made grand guardian, and General Who Garrisons the Army Liu Yu was additionally made palace attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and area commander over all military affairs inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, became grand marshal; Sima Zun, Prince of Wuling, grand guardian; and Liu Yu, general who garrisons the army, added palace attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and supreme area commander for forces throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔曰：「自頃國難之後，人物凋殘，常所供奉，猶不改舊，豈所以視人如傷，禹湯歸過之誡哉！

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict said: "Since the recent troubles of state, men and affairs have withered, yet the usual provisions supplied to the court remain unchanged from old times—how can this be the way to treat the people as wounded flesh, or heed the lesson of Yu and Tang who took blame upon themselves!
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the throne proclaimed: "After the calamities that have beset the realm, population and resources lie in ruins, yet palace outlays still follow the old scale—hardly the compassion due a bruised people, nor the self-reproach the sage kings Yu and Tang made their mirror."

sentences.zh: 可籌量減省。」

translations.literal: It is permitted to deliberate reductions and cutbacks."
translations.idiomatic: Let ministers calculate what may be pruned and spared."

sentences.zh: 夏四月，劉裕旋鎮京口。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Liu Yu returned to garrison Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Liu Yu withdrew to his headquarters at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，餞于東堂。

translations.literal: On wuchen, a farewell feast was held in the East Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the court held a parting banquet in the East Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，禁絹扇及摴蒲。

translations.literal: On guiwei of the fifth month, silk fans and chupu gaming were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the fifth month the use of silk fans and the chupu dice game was banned.

sentences.zh: 遊擊將軍、章武王秀，益州刺史司馬軌之謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: General Who Roams and Strikes, Prince Xiu of Zhangwu, and the inspector of Yizhou, Sima Gui-zhi, plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sima Xiu of Zhangwu, general who roams and strikes, and Sima Gui-zhi, inspector of Yizhou, conspired to revolt and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 桓玄故將桓亮、苻宏、刁預寇湘州，守將擊走之。

translations.literal: Former generals of Huan Xuan, Huan Liang, Fu Hong, and Diao Yu raided Xiangzhou; the garrison commanders attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Liang, Fu Hong, and Diao Yu, old officers of Huan Xuan, struck Xiangzhou, but local defenders beat them back.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲子，封臨川王子脩之爲會稽王。

translations.literal: On jiazi of autumn, the eighth month, the son of the Prince of Linchuan, Xiuzhi, was enfeoffed as Prince of Guiji.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month Sima Xiuzhi, son of the Prince of Linchuan, was invested as Prince of Guiji.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，乞付乾歸伐仇池，仇池公楊盛大破之。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, Qifu Gan'gui attacked Chouchi; the lord of Chouchi, Yang Sheng, inflicted a great defeat on him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Qifu Gan'gui campaigned against Chouchi; Yang Sheng, lord of Chouchi, shattered his army.

sentences.zh: 是歲，涼武昭王玄盛遣使奉表稱籓。

translations.literal: That year, the Martial and Luminous Prince of Liang, Li Gao, courtesy name Xuansheng, sent envoys with a memorial declaring submission.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Gao, courtesy Xuansheng, the ruler later honored as Prince Wu-Zhao of Liang, sent envoys with a memorial acknowledging Jin suzerainty.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，益州刺史司馬榮期擊譙縱將譙子明于白帝，破之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the second year, the inspector of Yizhou, Sima Rongqi, attacked Qiao Zong's general Qiao Ziming at Baidi and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yixi 2 Sima Rongqi, inspector of Yizhou, struck Qiao Ziming, a general of Qiao Zong, at Baidi and won.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，封高密王子法蓮爲高陽王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, the son of the Prince of Gaomi, Falian, was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Sima Falian, son of the Prince of Gaomi, was made prince of Gaoyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，梁州刺史楊孜敬有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the inspector of Liangzhou, Yang Zijing, was found guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yang Zijing, inspector of Liangzhou, was convicted and put to death.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，論匡復之功，封車騎將軍劉裕爲豫章郡公，撫軍將軍劉毅南平郡公，右將軍何無忌安成郡公，自餘封賞各有差。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, in reckoning merit for restoring the dynasty, General of Chariots and Cavalry Liu Yu was enfeoffed as Duke of Yuzhang, General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Yi as Duke of Nanping, General of the Right He Wuji as Duke of Ancheng, and the remaining enfeoffments and rewards differed by rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the court graded rewards for the restoration: Liu Yu became duke of Yuzhang as general of chariots and cavalry, Liu Yi duke of Nanping as general who pacifies the army, He Wuji duke of Ancheng as general of the right, with other grants scaled to service.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以左將軍孔安國爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On yihai, General of the Left Kong Anguo was made Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Kong Anguo, general of the left, was appointed left vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月，盜殺零陵太守阮野。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, bandits murdered the prefect of Lingling, Ruan Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month outlaws assassinated Ruan Ye, prefect of Lingling.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月己酉，車騎將軍劉裕來朝。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the second month of spring in the third year, General of Chariots and Cavalry Liu Yu came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the second month of Yixi 3 Liu Yu, general of chariots and cavalry, attended court.

sentences.zh: 誅東陽太守殷仲文、南蠻校尉殷叔文、晉陵太守殷道叔、永嘉太守駱球。

translations.literal: The prefect of Dongyang, Yin Zhongwen, the colonel of the southern barbarians Yin Shuwen, the prefect of Jinling, Yin Daoshu, and the prefect of Yongjia, Luo Qiu, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhongwen, prefect of Dongyang, Yin Shuwen, colonel of the southern barbarians, Yin Daoshu, prefect of Jinling, and Luo Qiu, prefect of Yongjia, were put to death.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大赦，除酒禁。

translations.literal: On jichou, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the wine prohibition was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the court declared a general amnesty and repealed the ban on wine.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，大水。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, there was great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month floods inundated wide areas.

sentences.zh: 六月，姚興將赫連勃勃僭稱天王于朔方，國號夏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Yao Xing's general Helian Bobo usurped the title heavenly king at Shuofang, with the state name Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Helian Bobo, a general of Yao Xing, proclaimed himself heavenly king at Shuofang and founded the state of Xia.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the first day of autumn, the seventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: New moon on wuxu in the seventh month: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 汝南王遵之有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: The Prince of Runan, Youzhi, was found guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Youzhi, Prince of Runan, was convicted and executed.

sentences.zh: 八月，遣冠軍將軍劉敬宣持節監征蜀諸軍事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, General Who Wins the Championship Liu Jingxuan was sent with staff of authority to supervise all military affairs for the expedition against Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liu Jingxuan, general who wins the championship, received the baton to oversee the Shu campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，赫連勃勃大敗禿髮傉檀，傉檀奔于南山。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, Helian Bobo inflicted a great defeat on Tufa Rutan; Rutan fled to Nanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Helian Bobo routed Tufa Rutan, who fled into the southern hills.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高雲、馮跋殺慕容熙，雲僭卽帝位。

translations.literal: That year, Gao Yun and Feng Ba murdered Murong Xi, and Yun usurped the imperial position.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gao Yun and Feng Ba killed Murong Xi; Gao Yun then unlawfully took the throne.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲辰，以琅邪王德文領司徒，車騎將軍劉裕爲揚州刺史、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the first month of spring in the fourth year, the Prince of Langye, Dewen, was made concurrent minister of education, and General of Chariots and Cavalry Liu Yu was made inspector of Yangzhou and recorder of secretariat matters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the first month of Yixi 4 Sima Dewen, Prince of Langye, added the ministry of education to his titles, while Liu Yu became inspector of Yangzhou and chief of secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，侍中、太保、武陵王遵薨。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Palace Attendant, Grand Guardian, Prince Zun of Wuling, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Sima Zun, palace attendant, grand guardian, and Prince of Wuling, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，散騎常侍、尚書左僕射孔安國卒。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Cavalier Attendant for Regular Service, Vice Director of the Left Kong Anguo, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Kong Anguo, regular cavalier attendant and left vice director of the secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，加吏部尚書孟昶尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel Meng Chang was additionally made Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Meng Chang, minister of personnel, was also named left vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛卯，雷。

translations.literal: On xinmao of winter, the eleventh month, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the eleventh month thunder rolled out of season.

sentences.zh: 梁州刺史楊思平有罪，棄市。

translations.literal: The inspector of Liangzhou, Yang Siping, was found guilty and exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Siping, inspector of Liangzhou, was convicted and executed in the public square.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大風拔樹。

translations.literal: On guichou, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou a gale tore trees from the ground.

sentences.zh: 是月，禿髮傉檀僭卽涼王位。

translations.literal: That month, Tufa Rutan usurped the title King of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tufa Rutan unlawfully proclaimed himself king of Liang.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛卯，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the first month of spring in the fifth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the first month of Yixi 5 the court ordered a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以撫軍將軍劉毅爲衛將軍、開府儀同三司，加輔國將軍何無忌鎮南將軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu, General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Yi was made General Who Guards the State, with equal ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, and General Who Supports the State He Wuji was additionally made General Who Guards the South.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Liu Yi, general who pacifies the army, became general who guards the state with three-excellency honors, while He Wuji, general who supports the state, added the title general who guards the south.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，尋陽地震。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Xunyang suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the same day Xunyang was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二月，慕容超將慕容興宗寇宿豫，陽平太守劉千載、南陽太守趙元並爲賊所執。

translations.literal: In the second month, Murong Chao's general Murong Xingzong raided Suyu; the prefect of Yangping, Liu Qianzai, and the prefect of Nanyang, Zhao Yuan, were both captured by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Murong Xingzong, Murong Chao's general, struck Suyu; Liu Qianzai, prefect of Yangping, and Zhao Yuan, prefect of Nanyang, were taken by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，大雪，平地數尺。

translations.literal: On jihai of the third month, heavy snow fell; on level ground it stood several chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the third month a blizzard piled snow several feet deep even on the flats.

sentences.zh: 車騎將軍劉裕帥師伐慕容超。

translations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry Liu Yu led an army to campaign against Murong Chao.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, general of chariots and cavalry, marched against Murong Chao.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丙寅，震于太廟。

translations.literal: On bingyin of summer, the sixth month, lightning struck the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the sixth month lightning blasted the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 劉裕大破慕容超于臨朐。

translations.literal: Liu Yu inflicted a great defeat on Murong Chao at Linqu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu shattered Murong Chao's army at Linqu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，姚興將乞伏乾歸僭稱西秦王于苑川。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Yao Xing's general Qifu Gan'gui usurped the title King of Western Qin at Yuanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Qifu Gan'gui, a general of Yao Xing, proclaimed himself king of Western Qin at Yuanchuan.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，離班弑高雲，雲將馮跋攻班，殺之。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the ninth month, Li Ban assassinated Gao Yun; Yun's general Feng Ba attacked Ban and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the ninth month Li Ban murdered Gao Yun; Feng Ba, Yun's officer, turned on Li Ban and slew him.

sentences.zh: 跋僭卽王位，仍號燕。

translations.literal: Ba usurped the royal position and still styled the state Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ba then unlawfully took the throne and continued to call his realm Yan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，魏清河王紹弑其主珪。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the Prince of Qinghe of Wei, Shao, murdered his lord Gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Tuoba Shao, Prince of Qinghe of Wei, assassinated his sovereign Tuoba Gui.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丁亥，劉裕攻慕容超，克之，齊地悉平。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the first month of spring in the sixth year, Liu Yu attacked Murong Chao, took him, and all Qi territory was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the first month of Yixi 6 Liu Yu stormed Murong Chao's defenses, captured him, and brought the whole of Qi under control.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣州刺史盧循反，寇江州。

translations.literal: That month, the inspector of Guangzhou, Lu Xun, rebelled and raided Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Lu Xun, inspector of Guangzhou, rose in revolt and struck Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，禿髮傉檀及沮渠蒙遜戰于窮泉，傉檀敗績。

translations.literal: In the third month, Tufa Rutan and Juqu Mengxun fought at Qiongquan; Rutan was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Tufa Rutan met Juqu Mengxun at Qiongquan and suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鎮南將軍、江州刺史何無忌及循戰于豫章，王師敗績，無忌死之。

translations.literal: On renshen, General Who Guards the South, inspector of Jiangzhou He Wuji, fought Lu Xun at Yuzhang; the imperial army was routed, and Wuji died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen He Wuji, general who guards the south and inspector of Jiangzhou, engaged Lu Xun at Yuzhang; government troops collapsed and He Wuji fell.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，青州刺史諸葛長民、兗州刺史劉籓、幷州刺史劉道憐乃入衛京師。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the inspector of Qingzhou, Zhuge Changmin, the inspector of Yanzhou, Liu Fan, and the inspector of Bingzhou, Liu Daolian, thereupon entered to defend the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zhuge Changmin of Qingzhou, Liu Fan of Yanzhou, and Liu Daolian of Bingzhou marched to the capital's relief.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，大風，拔木。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the fifth month, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the fifth month a violent wind tore up trees.

sentences.zh: 戊子，衛將軍劉毅及盧循戰于桑落洲，王師敗績。

translations.literal: On wuzi, General Who Guards the State Liu Yi fought Lu Xun at Sangluo Islet; the imperial army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Liu Yi, general who guards the state, met Lu Xun at Sangluo Islet and the loyalist army was shattered.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射孟昶懼，自殺。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Left Meng Chang, in fear, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Chang, left vice director of the secretariat, took his own life in panic.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，循至淮口，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On yichou, Xun reached the Huai mouth, and inside and outside were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Lu Xun's fleet reached the Huai estuary and the capital went on full alert.

sentences.zh: 大司馬、琅邪王德文都督宮城諸軍事，次中皇堂，太尉劉裕次石頭，梁王珍之屯南掖門，冠軍將軍劉敬宣屯北郊，輔國將軍孟懷玉屯南岸，建武將軍王仲德屯越城，廣武將軍劉懷默屯建陽門，淮口築柤浦、藥園、廷尉三壘以距之。

translations.literal: The Grand Marshal, Prince of Langye, Dewen, commanded all military affairs of the palace city and halted at the Central Imperial Hall; Grand Commandant Liu Yu encamped at Stone Fortress; Prince Zhenzhi of Liang garrisoned the south-side gate of the palace; General Who Wins the Championship Liu Jingxuan held the northern suburb; General Who Supports the State Meng Huaiyu manned the south bank of the Yangzi; General Who Establishes Might Wang Zhongde encamped at Yuecheng; General Who Displays Might Liu Huaimo held Jianyang Gate; three redoubts were built at Zhapu, Yaoyuan, and the office of the commandant of justice at the Huai mouth to block the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Dewen, grand marshal and Prince of Langye, took overall command of palace defenses from the Central Imperial Hall; Liu Yu, grand commandant, held Stone Fortress; Prince Zhenzhi of Liang sealed the south portal; Liu Jingxuan covered the northern outskirts; Meng Huaiyu, general who supports the state, lined the south bank; Wang Zhongde, general who establishes might, took Yuecheng; Liu Huaimo, general who displays might, guarded Jianyang Gate; and three field forts rose at Zhapu, Yaoyuan, and the commandant of justice's compound at the Huai mouth to bar Lu Xun's advance.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，震太廟鴟尾。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the owl-tail finial of the Grand Temple was struck by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin lightning shattered the ceramic owl-tail on the temple roof.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，盧循遁走。

translations.literal: On gengshen of autumn, the seventh month, Lu Xun fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the seventh month Lu Xun broke off and ran.

sentences.zh: 甲子，使輔國將軍王仲德、廣川太守劉鐘、河間內史蒯恩等帥衆追之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, General Who Supports the State Wang Zhongde, Prefect of Guangchuan Liu Zhong, and interior secretary of Hejian Kuai En were sent to lead troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wang Zhongde, Liu Zhong, prefect of Guangchuan, and Kuai En, interior secretary of Hejian, were ordered to pursue the rebels.

sentences.zh: 是月，盧循寇荊州，刺史劉道規、雍州刺史魯宗之等敗之。

translations.literal: That month, Lu Xun raided Jingzhou; the inspector Liu Daogui, the inspector of Yongzhou Lu Zongzhi, and others defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Lu Xun struck Jingzhou but Liu Daogui, Lu Zongzhi of Yongzhou, and their allies beat him back.

sentences.zh: 又破徐道覆于華容，賊復走尋陽。

translations.literal: They again defeated Xu Daofu at Huarong, and the bandits again fled to Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: They next routed Xu Daofu at Huarong, driving the rebels once more toward Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 八月，姚興將桓謙寇江陵，劉道規敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yao Xing's general Huan Qian raided Jiangling; Liu Daogui defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Huan Qian, a general of Yao Xing, attacked Jiangling; Liu Daogui repulsed him.
